### ST-044

**Graph model with provenance and confidence**

*As a **SmartTest engine**, I want **typed nodes and edges carrying provenance and confidence**, so that **evidence is never mixed without trace**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S3 | F01, F02, F08, §10.2, §10.3 | [ST-009](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-009) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Supports all §10.2 node kinds and §10.3 edge kinds
- [x] Every edge has `provenance` and `confidence`; unknown stays unknown
- [x] Uncertainty metadata (unresolved imports, dynamic patterns) attaches to nodes

---

### ST-045

**Persistent graph storage**

*As a **developer**, I want **the graph persisted locally**, so that **warm runs don't rebuild everything**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S3 | F03, §8.3 | [ST-044](GRA-dependency-graph.md#st-044), [ST-013](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-013) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Graph stored in `.smarttest/state/index.db` with a schema version and migrations
- [x] Corrupt or incompatible stores are detected and rebuilt with a warning
- [x] Writes are transactional

---

### ST-046

**Reverse and transitive traversal with cycle safety**

*As a **SmartTest engine**, I want **fast reverse-dependency and transitive queries**, so that **every test reachable from a change is found**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S4 | F04, F05, F06, §10.7 | [ST-045](GRA-dependency-graph.md#st-045) |

**Status:** ✅ done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] Reverse traversal returns paths, not only node sets
- [x] Cycles terminate and are reported
- [x] Warm selection query < 200 ms on the medium benchmark repo

---

### ST-047

**Incremental graph updates**

*As a **developer**, I want **the graph updated incrementally after changes**, so that **analysis cost scales with the change, not the repo**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🟥 Must | 5 | S5 | F07 | [ST-046](GRA-dependency-graph.md#st-046), [ST-042](SRC-source-intelligence.md#st-042) |

**Status:** 🟡 partial — Analyses are cached incrementally; the graph is rebuilt in memory from the cache (tens of ms at 2,000 modules) instead of being patched in place.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Updating one file rewrites only its nodes/edges in one transaction
- [ ] Result is identical to a full rebuild (property test over fixture edits)
- [ ] Batch updates are supported for large change sets

---
